spell.bhspellsx.embracing_bosom.guide: Channel to plant a warding circle at your feet. Players standing in it are healed periodically and take reduced damage while blessed; harmful effects applied to them expire faster.
spell.bhspellsx.amethyst_decree.guide: Channel to erupt a burst of amethyst around you. Enemies caught in the blast take heavy damage, are rooted and stunned, and are weakened while lingering crystal damage wears them down.
